derivation.summary: Translate reusable engineering and evaluation lessons into Astra-native reference data without importing Ponytail runtime behavior.

principles.statement: Prefer the smallest change that is correct at the real causal location, not merely the smallest textual diff.
checks: understand the affected flow before editing
identify the shared causal point before patching callers
avoid unrelated edits

principles.statement: Before building a new mechanism, determine whether the requested capability needs new code at all.
checks: is the requested behavior already available
is the requirement speculative rather than current
can the task be satisfied without creating a new abstraction

principles.statement: Prefer an existing local helper, type, pattern, or shared function over a duplicate implementation.
checks: search the local codebase first
reuse the established path when semantics match
do not add a parallel implementation without evidence that reuse is insufficient

principles.statement: Prefer standard-library and native platform capabilities before adding custom code or a new dependency.
checks: standard library capability
native platform capability
already-installed dependency
new dependency only when the prior options are insufficient

principles.statement: For defects, trace callers and shared paths so the correction is applied once at the causal convergence point when appropriate.
checks: trace relevant callers
separate reported symptom from causal defect
prefer one shared correction over repeated caller-specific guards when semantics permit

principles.statement: Prefer removing dead or speculative complexity over adding scaffolding for hypothetical future needs.
checks: no abstraction with no demonstrated variation
no configuration that has no present consumer
no boilerplate solely for possible future expansion

principles.statement: Minimization must not remove trust-boundary validation, data-loss prevention, security controls, accessibility basics, or explicitly required behavior.
checks: trust-boundary validation remains present
error handling that prevents data loss remains present
security controls remain present
accessibility basics remain present
explicit task requirements remain present

principles.statement: Non-trivial logic should retain the smallest runnable check that would fail if the changed behavior regresses.
checks: the check executes rather than merely documents
the check targets the changed logic
test scaffolding is not expanded beyond what the risk requires

evaluation_lessons.lesson: Evaluate coding-agent effects on the resulting repository artifact or diff rather than conversational verbosity alone.
Isolate benchmark arms so global plugins, hooks, prompts, or shared state cannot contaminate the baseline.
A minimization policy should be tested against cases where fewer lines could incorrectly remove a safety guard.
A credible benchmark should permit minimal and baseline approaches to converge when the task is already irreducible.
When a stronger benchmark weakens an earlier claim, retain the stronger method and narrow the claim instead of protecting the earlier number.

astra_application_hypotheses.hypothesis: Astra candidate planning may use the decision order to rank lower-complexity implementation paths before proposing new code.
Astra candidate review may separately inspect unnecessary complexity while leaving correctness, security, and governance review as independent concerns.
Any future activation should be evaluated with matched tasks, isolated contexts, repository-level diffs, runtime checks, and explicit safety cases.
